subject: FLASH: W1-2 luck signal landed (13/13 tests) + DAVE walk-forward measured + split-weight killed + forceReprice boundary
body:
Agent 1 (GLM/Flash/Hermes) shift deliverables, all on Sports branch hermes/opp-adj-epa-20260919 @ 3e62e64d8 (pushed), artifacts in docs/research/2026-09-19-opp-adj-epa-path/:

1. TURNOVER-LUCK SIGNAL LANDED: packages/prediction-engine/src/signals/luck/turnover-luck.ts + 13/13 tests green (npx vitest run src/__tests__/turnover-luck.test.ts), engine tsc clean. Pure shrunk-recovery evaluator, K_FF=200, baseline 0.50, K_INT=150 exported. Fixtures carry the MEASURED W1-2 counts. HONESTY CORRECTION to the directive list: BAL/CAR/NYJ extremes are n=1 (one fumble each) - the module floors them at NEUTRAL+lowSample (MIN_FUMBLES_FOR_VERDICT=2). True extremes: TB/CHI/HOU unlucky (0% on 2-4 fumbles), KC/BUF/ATL lucky (100% on 2-3). Registry/index wiring left to the Gemini batch lane - module is standalone, zero conflicts with Batch 7/8 files.

2. DAVE WALK-FORWARD (Task 2 measurable half): full rolling-origin 2025 season, every week scored from prior-week fits only, per-week fitted logistic scales both sides, 256/272 games: ADJ Brier 0.2512 / logloss 0.6958 / acc 0.535 vs MARKET 0.2044 / 0.5902 / 0.645. Single-split window (W1-8 fit, W9-18 test) was the favorable end (0.2368 vs 0.2200, n=151). Conclusion: DAVE is a weak Rung-2 prior over a real season - consistent with Grok's CRPS framing and with the multi-season NULL. Scale reconciliation: our fits read 42.54 pts/EPA (train window) and 45.42 (full-season own-agg); the circulating 36.6 figure matches neither - publish the filter set before using it.

3. SPLIT-WEIGHT KILL LINE FIRED: pre-registered w=0.75 dropback weighting must beat pooled on BOTH 2024 and 2025 holdouts - it won 2025 (SP 0.322 vs 0.295) and lost 2024 (0.429 vs 0.446). Optimal weight is season-dependent; fixed 0.75/0.25 NOT established. The ~2:1 descriptive pass-vs-rush asymmetry stands; use it for factor design, not margin arithmetic.

4. FORCE REPRICE NOT EXECUTED - law 7 boundary: it writes picks.factorBreakdown in production. Operator instructions in the research README (Task 2 section): founder-triggered /api/cron/backfill-independent-trueprob with forceReprice:true once; verify via sources-distribution SQL + cron response fields.

5. REMINDER (unpicked up in consensus): W5 constants hazard - shipped NFL_EPA_MARGIN_SCALE=0.12 scores holdout Brier 0.3035 (worse than coin flip) vs 0.2694 fitted. Founder decision before 2026-10-08.
